title: 双的

blocks.ipa: suã⁵⁵ ti⁵⁵
blocks.ye: Suanx dix
blocks.zh: 双的；双数。
blocks.en: Paired; an even number

culturalNote: 土家人喜欢双数，娶媳妇一般选择双数日子，认为好事成双，双喜临门。送礼金、买礼物喜欢带“六”的数字，有六就意味着六六大顺。过年做十二道菜，寓意月月发，正月初一做四道菜，寓意四季发财。
culturalNoteEn: Tujia people favor even numbers. Weddings are usually held on even-numbered dates, since good things are believed to come in pairs and double happiness enters the home. Cash gifts and presents often contain the number six, invoking the blessing ‘everything goes smoothly in sixes.’ Twelve dishes are prepared for New Year to symbolize prosperity in every month; four dishes are made on the first day of the lunar year to symbolize prosperity through all four seasons.

Suanx dix
双的；双数。
Paired; an even number

culturalNoteEn: On the first day of the lunar year, Tujia communities traditionally carry firewood home from the mountains. Bringing firewood into the house symbolizes wealth entering in the new year, because ‘firewood’ and ‘wealth’ are both pronounced [tsʰai²¹] in the local Chinese dialect.

blocks.zh: 咚咚喹，咚咚喹。到永顺街上玩去了，到保靖街上踢毽子去了。哩哩拉拉咚咚喹，到隆头街上喝水去了，到井洞坡爬坡去了。咚咚喹，巴列媳子坐月子。她自己坐，先煎三个鸡蛋，再杀一个公鸡。明后天外公外婆要来看望，送摇篮、送被子，小狗要带来，糖糍、鸡、鸡蛋全都挑来，还有猪腿也要背来。
blocks.en: Dongdongkui, dongdongkui. We went to Yongshun to play and to Baojing to kick shuttlecocks. We went to Longtou to drink water and climbed the slope at Jingdong. The Balie daughter-in-law is in postpartum confinement: first fry three eggs, then kill a rooster. Her maternal grandparents will visit, bringing a cradle, quilt, puppy, rice sweets, chicken, eggs and a pork leg.

culturalNote: 这是一首以“咚咚喹”为衬词的童谣，歌词串联永顺、保靖、隆头、井洞等地方。
culturalNoteEn: A children's rhyme built around the refrain ‘dongdongkui.’ Its journey through Yongshun, Baojing, Longtou and Jingdong anchors the song in familiar regional places.

Dongdongkui, dongdongkui. We went to Yongshun to play and to Baojing to kick shuttlecocks. We went to Longtou to drink water and climbed the slope at Jingdong. The Balie daughter-in-law is in postpartum confinement: first fry three eggs, then kill a rooster. Her maternal grandparents will visit, bringing a cradle, quilt, puppy, rice sweets, chicken, eggs and a pork leg.
这是一首以“咚咚喹”为衬词的童谣，歌词串联永顺、保靖、隆头、井洞等地方。

blocks.zh: 出太阳了，下雨了。对面路上是谁呀？我把他捉过来耕地吧！先把赶牛的细棍子折弯，把牛轭连接起来；但团圈断了，小牛就在犁路里趴下了。
blocks.en: The sun has come out; rain has fallen. Who is on the road opposite? Let me catch him and make him plough. Bend the cattle switch, join the yoke—but the connecting loop breaks, and the calf lies down in the furrow.

culturalNote: 这是一首带有劳动生活色彩的童谣，以天晴下雨为引子，写耕地、赶牛和田间劳作。
culturalNoteEn: A playful work song in which changes between sunshine and rain frame scenes of ploughing, handling cattle and field labor.

blocks.zh: 老天老天快下雨，倾盆大雨下下来；老天老天快下雨，大鱼顺水流下来。父母上山做工去，没拿蓑衣和斗笠，快些收工回家来。老天老天快下雨，倾盆大雨下下来；快把塘里水流满，好养鱼来好养鸭。
blocks.en: Sky, sky, let rain fall quickly; let a downpour stream down, and let big fish follow the water. Mother and father have gone to work in the hills without rain capes or hats—come home from work quickly. Fill the pond with water so we can raise fish and ducks.

culturalNote: 这是一首祈雨歌，希望大雨落下，让上山做工的父母回家，也让池塘蓄水、鱼儿生长。
culturalNoteEn: A rain-calling song: heavy rain is asked to fall so parents can return from hillside work, ponds can fill and fish can thrive.

blocks.en: Hammer the iron, hammer the iron. Where has Grandfather Blacksmith gone? He carried away the backbasket and the small wood knife and led away the puppy. Hammer the iron—Grandfather Blacksmith went to carry firewood.

culturalNoteEn: The repeated syllables imitate a blacksmith's hammer. The verse turns the rhythm of forging iron and the blacksmith's movements into song.

blocks.en: Smoke, smoke, drift that way; put a drop of oil over there. Smoke, smoke, drift that way; the little mouse has come out and gone that way.

culturalNote: 这首儿歌多在火塘生火、烟熏人时念，据说念了烟就不会再熏人。
culturalNoteEn: This rhyme was commonly recited when hearth smoke blew toward a person; people believed that chanting it would make the smoke turn away.

blocks.en: Ailolo, ailolo. Little brother, do not cry; be good. When you grow up you will herd cattle: tend one and gain another, with no other household work. Little sister, do not cry; be good. When you grow up you will spin hemp, weave cloth, sew new clothes and wear them.

culturalNoteEn: These are two lullabies. The singer selects different verses according to the child's sex: the boy is imagined herding cattle, while the girl is imagined spinning hemp, weaving and making clothes.

Ailolo, ailolo. Little brother, do not cry; be good. When you grow up you will herd cattle: tend one and gain another, with no other household work. Little sister, do not cry; be good. When you grow up you will spin hemp, weave cloth, sew new clothes and wear them.
这是两首摇篮曲，吟唱者根据孩子的性别选择内容：男孩长大守牛，女孩长大绩麻、织布、缝衣。

blocks.zh: 姐在楼上忙织花，我在你们屋后挖生土；我口又干、肚又饿，姐碗中饭没送我。哥在屋后挖土，你也口干肚饿。我们相互不认识，跟我有什么关系？姐姐，我告诉你：姐的眼睛不认人。我们以前就相好，今天你却不认人。哥哥哥哥叫声你，姐是有口没有心；我日也思来夜也想，两人何时到一起？
blocks.en: Sister weaves upstairs while I dig behind your house; I am thirsty and hungry, but you sent me no bowl of rice. Brother digs behind the house, also thirsty and hungry—yet we do not know each other, so what is that to me? Sister, your eyes fail to recognize me: we loved each other before, but today you deny me. Brother, do not think my words are my heart; I think of you day and night—when will we be together?

culturalNoteEn: An antiphonal courtship song performed by a man and a woman. Teasing accusations give way to a declaration that both have long cared for each other.

blocks.en: A man surnamed Wang had only one son, a large but very foolish young man who could neither work nor speak clearly.

blocks.en: The son copied this too, stuffing noodles into his nostrils until his furious father beat him.

blocks.zh: 回家后，父亲坐在火坑边叹气。妻子问他为什么不高兴，父亲讲起上街滑倒、儿子又倒掉另一桶油、自己一怒打了儿子的经过，担忧以后日子难过。故事就这样结束。
blocks.en: Back home the father sat by the hearth and lamented to his wife that life with such a foolish son would be very hard.

culturalNote: 这是一篇带有劝诫意味的笑话故事。儿子机械模仿父亲，把桐油倒掉，又模仿父亲把面条弄进鼻子，说明只会照做而不懂情境会闹出笑话。
culturalNoteEn: A comic cautionary tale about a father and his literal-minded son. The son's mechanical imitation—spilling oil and copying his father's mishap with noodles—shows the danger of following instructions without understanding context.

blocks.zh: 从前陈家寨有两兄弟，弟弟陈二郎最爱戏弄人。一天，他突然来找哥哥，提议两人一起进城，打赌到了城里会有人喊他却没人喊哥哥，赌五两银子。
blocks.en: Long ago, at a Chen family stockade, there were two brothers. The younger brother loved teasing people. One day he suddenly came to his elder brother and proposed that they go to town together, betting five taels of silver on whether people would call out to him but not to the elder brother.

culturalNote: 这是一则地方机智故事。陈二郎把请他坐下喝茶的话写在衣服上，路人读出文字，哥哥误以为人人都在喊陈二郎，因而输掉赌约。
culturalNoteEn: A local trickster tale. Chen Erlang wins a wager by writing an invitation to ‘Chen Erlang’ on his clothing, so passers-by read the words aloud and his brother mistakes this for people greeting him.

blocks.zh: 从隆头去龙山要经过庆口。庆口那里有一条大路，人来人往，往城里挑担的人也都从那里走。
blocks.en: Travel from Longtou to Longshan once required passing Qingkou. There was a large road there, busy with people coming and going, and those carrying loads to town all went that way.

blocks.zh: 庆口那里有一条很深的河谷，深有三十几丈。没有办法直接通过，也没有路可走，只能绕到山包上，上上下下地绕路去龙山。
blocks.en: At Qingkou there was a very deep river valley, more than thirty zhang deep. There was no direct road through it, so people had to detour along the hillside, going up and down with great difficulty.

blocks.zh: 我们多谷这里有个有钱人彭泽畔，经常从庆口往来做生意。骑马经过庆口很不方便，他家境很好，便准备在那里修一座桥。
blocks.en: A wealthy man, Peng Zepan, often had to pass through Qingkou for business. Because riding through there was inconvenient, he decided to spend money to build a bridge.

blocks.zh: 修桥准备了三天三夜后开工，派长工四处找石匠、小工和做饭的人，百多人到了庆口。
blocks.en: After three days and three nights of preparation, the bridge work began. Workers were sent out to call masons, laborers and cooks, and more than a hundred people came to Qingkou.

blocks.en: They set up shelters, killed cattle and pigs, prepared wine and firecrackers, and opened the bridge work with great noise and excitement.

blocks.zh: 石匠们在庆口叮叮当当地凿石头，声音像打雷一样，凿桥墩凿了半年多。
blocks.en: The masons worked at Qingkou with a clanging sound like thunder. They hammered stone and cut bridge piers for half a year.

blocks.en: Even after all that work, the project still did not make progress. Peng Zepan had to add more workers, and Longtou street filled with craftsmen.

blocks.en: He then repaired the stele overnight. The repair was so skillful that no trace could be seen on the front, and the bridge could finally be finished.

blocks.en: After the bridge was completed, the donor names were carved on the stele. The narrator says he has crossed Qingkou Bridge several times, touched the repaired stele with his own hands, and seen how the wedge stone and stele stood in place.

blocks.en: The bridge stood high over the valley on the road from Longtou to Longshan, with rails and a span that people could cross. The narrator describes its shape and the place where the repaired stele stood.

blocks.en: During the completion feast, people could not find the young mason. When they looked up, they saw him rising into the sky. They then understood that he was an immortal who had come down to help Peng Zepan build Qingkou Bridge.

culturalNote: 这是庆口桥的地方传说，记录旧时往来龙山道路艰难、众人集资出工、石碑刻捐资者姓名，以及神秘小石匠下凡助建桥梁的故事。
culturalNoteEn: An origin story for Qingkou Bridge. It remembers the difficulty of regional travel, communal labor, donor names carved on a stone stele and a mysterious young mason believed to be a deity who enabled the bridge to be completed.

Lunr tour lair lunr sanx box yif laix jif koux lav kax dor. ax dix yiuf sir daf lux; lov hunv hunr hunv hunr. aix sir jier cer lir bor gur ar yif six, lox deix liv yier sov yif six biav dar keiv bor mor haf yif niex jir. jiuf jif kour aix dix yiar guf pav lar hur lav jief.
从隆头去龙山要经过庆口。庆口那里有一条大路，人来人往，往城里挑担的人也都从那里走。
Travel from Longtou to Longshan once required passing Qingkou. There was a large road there, busy with people coming and going, and those carrying loads to town all went that way.

Af dix yianr guf laix sex jir taif, sanx sir jiv zaf sex jief. enf qif qix baf huar taix, nif lav raov zor taix. raov dor enx geix baox baox gar lair raov dor. yif banf yiex lanr zunx laix ar pianx pianx dix bor yif sax yif jiax bor. haf lar lav dox jiux bor dar, hanf raov lar aix lex meir lunr sanx bor yif lax.
庆口那里有一条很深的河谷，深有三十几丈。没有办法直接通过，也没有路可走，只能绕到山包上，上上下下地绕路去龙山。
At Qingkou there was a very deep river valley, more than thirty zhang deep. There was no direct road through it, so people had to detour along the hillside, going up and down with great difficulty.

Anf geir dox gux lair jief mar zair taof bax lav hur jief, punr ceir panf. gof laix yif six enx geix sex yix rix ax, zaf ar, lunr tur lair jif kouv box ar jiv yif lax. mav jiv bor, yif bur huanx biax. gof cuv jiax wur caf jix taix, gof laix gof gox zuev bir aox cair qiaor laox jiux.
我们多谷这里有个有钱人彭泽畔，经常从庆口往来做生意。骑马经过庆口很不方便，他家境很好，便准备在那里修一座桥。
A wealthy man, Peng Zepan, often had to pass through Qingkou for business. Because riding through there was inconvenient, he decided to spend money to build a bridge.

Qiaor jiux laix enf sox paix sox niex jiaf six liaox. saf gov aix lex car gur gof car gur yif ef sir gof, jief car gur yir ef sir gor par jiex ar laix. enr geir sir daox bax cux ngair jiar nix mav nix, jiaox gux nix mav nix, yier baf mav nix, hanf lov beif bax tax cir huf nix ar dir. qif bax tianx hif niex lair beif bax tax cir huf nix aox yiex jir liaor.
修桥准备了三天三夜后开工，派长工四处找石匠、小工和做饭的人，百多人到了庆口。
After three days and three nights of preparation, the bridge work began. Workers were sent out to call masons, laborers and cooks, and more than a hundred people came to Qingkou.

Aox cair yiuf wox pir dar, aox cair jiaf jiux box jiux lar. jif kouv huf nix dox lov zuf zar jif liaox, wunr zor taix ax lair jiux. gof wuaf niex lunx zix niex lunx af buf wor mor, reif ax jif dar, aox tuar deif niex lov zair yif ax lair. huf nix aox gaf, paof zux pox bor mor, laof reix jix taix. aix jiux ar lair dif ef tiax jiuf aix lex jiux lar hur.
他们在那里搭棚居住，杀牛杀猪，备酒放爆竹，热热闹闹地开始修桥。
They set up shelters, killed cattle and pigs, prepared wine and firecrackers, and opened the bridge work with great noise and excitement.

blocks.en: When the porridge was ready, they carried it into the courtyard and poured it onto the roads, covering all the paths until they had spread it right up to the gate.

blocks.en: He saw that people in the human world were wasting grain this way, pouring millet porridge all over the ground. It was outrageous, so he said he would go down and look.

blocks.en: The Thunder God came down to the human world and went to the gate of the Manli elder brother's household. Seeing porridge spread everywhere, he slowly walked to the gate, where still more had been poured, slipped, and fell.

blocks.en: They kept him shut in for three days and three nights. The five brothers also warned the villagers that no one should bring the Thunder God fire or water.

blocks.en: With fire and water, the Thunder God would escape. In the village there were two siblings from the Luo Jiwu household.

blocks.en: They were kind-hearted. Luo Jifu saw the Thunder God shut in so pitifully and thirsty, said he would bring him water, and then brought him water.

blocks.en: His younger sister Luo Jilian brought him fire. The Thunder God then raised yin fire and yang fire, burst the iron chest open, and escaped.

blocks.en: The Thunder God fled in panic up to the heavenly court and reported to the Jade Emperor: 'Jade Emperor, this time the five brothers of the Manli elder brother's household in the human world shut me in an iron chest for three days and three nights.'

glosses.en: ran up to the heavenly court
the household of Manli elder brother
shut in for three days and nights

blocks.en: 'They nearly shut me in until I died; I was dying of thirst.' The Jade Emperor asked why they had shut him in. The Thunder God said that they had poured millet porridge on the road; when he went to look, he slipped and was caught.

blocks.en: When I went to look, I slipped, and they caught me at the gate. Then the Jade Emperor ordered the Thunder God to drown the people below with a sky-high flood.

Ngax bor ceir lief box cix
Ceir hor lair nganf ngax tix

blocks.zh: 于是让雷公给他们搭下一根绳子，给兄妹送一粒葫芦种子，叫他们种在园子里；种下以后，马上就会长出葫芦。
blocks.en: So he had the Thunder God lower a rope for them and send the siblings a gourd seed, telling them to plant it in the garden; once planted, it would quickly sprout into a gourd.

glosses.ye: Aix maix nif jiux hanf lanr lair
Nif yeif lax jir tar daf lair

blocks.zh: 种下以后，马上结果，马上就会熟。熟了以后，他们把葫芦中间剖开、把里面掏空，葫芦就像船一样。
blocks.en: After it was planted, it quickly bore fruit and ripened. Once ripe, they split the gourd open, hollowed out the middle, and it became like a boat.

glosses.ye: Zuv ganr laf dunx gux zux

blocks.zh: 那粒葫芦种子当夜种下，第二天就发芽、长出苗子；第三天牵藤，第四天开花。
blocks.en: They planted the gourd seed that night. On the second day it sprouted and sent up a shoot; on the third day it put out vines; on the fourth day it flowered.

blocks.zh: 第五天就结果了，第六天葫芦就成熟了。于是他们把它摘下来，剖开肚子、掏空里面，像船一样大。
blocks.en: On the fifth day it bore fruit, and on the sixth day the gourd ripened. They picked it, opened its belly, hollowed out the inside, and it was as large as a boat.

blocks.ye: Aix lex gar haf laix meif tax ceir meif zeiaf diux, piaor daof div yiar, qif tianx qif yiex zeir. af nix jir tar huanr jiar sanx niex laiv dox gox nganx jix liaox.
blocks.zh: 这时，上面的雷公下起雨来，哗啦啦下了七天七夜。我们下面凡间世上的人都被水淹完了。
blocks.en: Then the Thunder God above sent rain, pouring down for seven days and seven nights. The people in the human world below were all drowned.

glosses.en: rained for seven days and seven nights

blocks.ye: Lov huf nix taiux jix lar hur. nganf mor lanr tianx menr qir liaor. geiv rev gar niav hur lair qianr kaox aix dix huf zix piaor piaox wof tux wunr bor mor, piaov piaov piaov lair, piaov piaov piaov lair, enr geir lanr tianx menr lax mir tar yiex liaox. aix lex lair qif tianx suif ax, qif tianx qif yiex lair qif tianx suif gov dor dof jiav lur.
blocks.zh: 人都快被淹死了，水涨到南天门边。罗吉富兄妹两个全靠坐在那个葫芦里，漂啊漂，漂到了南天门边。七天七夜以后，齐天洪水自己流完了。
blocks.en: People were nearly all drowned, and the water rose to the Southern Gate of Heaven. Luo Jifu and his sister survived by sitting inside the gourd, drifting and drifting until they reached the Southern Gate of Heaven. After seven days and seven nights, the sky-high flood drained away by itself.

glosses.en: flooded up to the Southern Gate of Heaven
there, at the Southern Gate of Heaven

blocks.ye: Aix lex geiv rex gax niav hur yif ax lair aox cair yif jier, taif beir jix jix pav dor liaor. seif rex gar niav hur muf lanx jir tar huanr jiar sanx ngax lov taiuf av.
blocks.zh: 这时，他们兄妹两个走到那里，碰见了太白金星。太白金星说：“你们兄妹两个，现在下面凡间上已经没有人了。”
blocks.en: Then the two siblings went there and met Taibai Jinxing. Taibai Jinxing said, “You two siblings: now there are no people left in the human world below.”

blocks.ipa: sei³⁵ ze⁵⁵ ka⁵⁵ nia⁵³ xu⁵⁵ ai⁵⁵ le⁵⁵ ze⁵⁵ ka⁵⁵ nia⁵³ xu²¹ to⁵⁵ tsʰe²¹ tɕʰɨ⁵⁵ ti²¹ xu²¹, sei³⁵ xã⁵⁵ tsʰei³⁵ xo⁵⁵ tsʰei²¹ tʰa²¹? a³⁵ ni⁵⁵ tei⁵⁵ ze⁵⁵ ka⁵⁵ nia⁵³ xu²¹ nie²¹ lau⁵⁵ nie²¹ mie⁵³ ta²¹ po²¹ ci⁵⁵, ai²¹ nie²¹ lau⁵⁵ nie²¹ pa²¹ lau⁵⁵ nie²¹ mie⁵³ kʰu²¹ po²¹ ci⁵⁵.
blocks.ye: Seif rex gax niav hux aix lex rex gax niav hur dox cer qix dir hur, seif hanx ceif hox ceir tar? af nix deix rex gax niav hur nier laox nier miev dar bor cix, air nier laox nier bar laox nier miev kur bor cix.
blocks.zh: “你们兄妹两个都已经长成大人了，你们愿意不愿意？”他们回答：“我们兄妹两个是一个母亲的血滴着的，是一个父亲的血吸着的。”
blocks.en: “You two siblings have both grown up; are you willing or not?” They answered, “We two siblings are blood from one mother and blood from one father.”

glosses.en: have both become ready to marry

blocks.ye: Renx gax dax har qianf cer qix yior? aix manx gaov ar tix, aix gaov ar tix hanf lanr, seir sif zaix gaov tax lair ngaf sif bor banf huax laox lir, seif enx geix wunx cair box zox yir huf çief, af enx bov zor yir huf laix, div diav lair jir tar baox baox jir tar bor çiaox af lier.
blocks.zh: “兄妹一起怎么能成亲呢？那样肯定不行。”太白金星说：“既然你们实在不愿意，我给你们说个办法。这里有一副磨子，把这副磨子抬到下面山坡去，往下面推下去。”
blocks.en: “How could siblings marry? That certainly cannot be done.” Taibai Jinxing said, “If you truly are unwilling, I will give you a way to test it. There is a pair of millstones here; carry them to the slope below and push them down.”

glosses.ye: Seir sif zaix gaov tax lair
glosses.en: if you truly cannot do it

glosses.ye: Ngaf sif bor banf huax laox lir
glosses.en: I will tell a way to test it
there is a pair of millstones

blocks.zh: 石磨往山坡下面推了下去。如果那副磨子真是灵巧的，怎么样都可以。推下去以后，两块磨子又合在了一起。这样罗吉富兄妹两个也没有办法了。
blocks.en: They pushed the millstones down the slope. If the millstones were truly efficacious, anything would be possible. After being pushed down, the two stones came together again. In this way Luo Jifu and his sister had no other choice.

glosses.ye: Lor jir huf renx gar niav hur

blocks.ye: Aix qianf lir ar? lir zor taix. aix mair hanf lanr, ar nix manx renv gar niav hur enx dix hanf lanr lair air kox bax gar rux gar, wunr qief gar ruv gar. aix hanf lanr, seif kox bax gar rux gar seif jief zux pur boix, wunr qief gar ruv gor ruv gar seif enx geix wunv gor diev bor.
blocks.zh: 他们还能说什么呢？已经没有话可说。兄妹两个又说：“我们头上害羞，耳朵上也害羞。”太白金星说：“头上害羞就系上头帕，耳朵上害羞就戴上耳环，这样你们就不会害羞了。”
blocks.en: What else could they say? There was nothing left to say. The siblings said, “Our heads feel ashamed, and our ears also feel ashamed.” Taibai Jinxing answered, “If your heads are ashamed, tie on headscarves; if your ears are ashamed, wear earrings. Then you will not be ashamed.”

glosses.ye: Enx geix wunv gor diev bor

blocks.zh: 他们又说：“我们脚板害羞。”太白金星说：“脚板害羞就给你们穿上鞋子。”兄妹又说：“我们两个一起睡，身上害羞。”太白金星又说：“身上害羞，就用被子盖着。”
blocks.en: They said again, “The soles of our feet feel ashamed.” Taibai Jinxing replied, “If your feet are ashamed, put on shoes.” The siblings then said, “When the two of us sleep together, our bodies feel ashamed.” Taibai Jinxing said, “If your bodies are ashamed, cover yourselves with a quilt.”

Ar nix sox tiur ruv gar
Renv gar niav hur dax nief box
Sŋx lanx niex pux hor lair dur bor

blocks.zh: 后来过了几个月，就有了身孕。太白金星又到玉皇大帝那里去报告，说罗吉富家的兄妹两个已经有孕了，很快要生了。
blocks.en: After several months, she became pregnant. Taibai Jinxing again went to the Jade Emperor to report that the siblings in Luo Jifu's household were expecting a child and would soon give birth.

blocks.ipa: ai⁵⁵ le⁵⁵ ai⁵⁵ la⁵⁵ nie⁵⁵ lũ⁵⁵ liau⁵⁵, lũ⁵³ lai²¹ lo⁵³ lũ⁵³ ji³⁵ sŋ⁵⁵ mie⁵⁵ kʰu⁵⁵ mie⁵⁵ ta⁵⁵ çie³⁵ kʰuai⁵⁵ kʰuai⁵⁵ ji³⁵ tʰa⁵⁵ lũ⁵³ po²¹, tɕi⁵³ tsʰo²¹ tɕi²¹ çie³⁵. ai⁵⁵ le⁵⁵ tʰai³⁵ pei²¹ tɕi⁵⁵ tɕi⁵⁵ jiou³⁵ ẽ²¹ kei²¹ yi³⁵ a⁵⁵ lai⁵⁵ ji³⁵ xuã²¹ ta³⁵ ti³⁵ po⁵⁵ tsei³⁵ çie⁵⁵.
blocks.ye: Aix lex aix lax niex lunx liaox, lunv lair lov lunv yif sŋx miex kux miex dax çief kuaix kuaix yif tax lunv bor, jiv cor jir çief. aix lex taif beir jix jix yiuf enr geir yif ax laix yif huanr daf dif box zeif çiex.
blocks.zh: 后来有一天生了，生下来的不是人，而是一团血糊糊、血块块一样的东西。太白金星又走到玉皇大帝那里去报告。
blocks.en: Then one day she gave birth. What was born was not a person, but a bloody mass, like lumps of blood. Taibai Jinxing again went to report to the Jade Emperor.

glosses.ye: Yif sŋx miex kux miex dax

blocks.zh: 玉皇大帝说：“罗吉富家虽然生了，但生的不是人，是血块。你们把那血块同三担六斗小米大米、三担六斗泥巴和在一起，好好剁碎、混合，然后往四处撒。”
blocks.en: The Jade Emperor said, “Although Luo Jifu's household has given birth, what was born is not a person but a blood mass. Mix that blood mass with three loads and six pecks of millet and rice and the same amount of earth, chop and mix it well, and scatter it in all directions.”

blocks.en: So the two siblings of Luo Jifu's household chopped and mixed the blood mass together with earth and grain, then scattered it in all directions. Where it fell on an embankment, it became the Kang surname.

blocks.zh: 又往竹林里撒了一下，就成了朱姓。又往田里撒了一下，就成了田姓。
blocks.en: They also scattered some in the bamboo grove, and it became the Zhu surname. They scattered some in the fields, and it became the Tian surname.

blocks.zh: 又往茅棚上撒了一下，就成了彭姓。又往水沟上撒了一下，就成了何姓。
blocks.en: They scattered some on a thatched shed, and it became the Peng surname. They scattered some by a water ditch, and it became the He surname.

blocks.zh: 东西南北都撒完了，四处都撒完了，那里就冒起炊烟，有了人烟。最后撒完的地方，就成了王姓；于是凡间又有人发了。
blocks.en: They scattered it east, west, everywhere, until all was scattered. Smoke rose again and there were human dwellings. Where the last of it was scattered, it became the Wang surname; in this way people arose again in the human world.

The five brothers seized him. After catching him, they bound him with iron rope and shut him in an iron chest.

With fire and water, the Thunder God would escape. In the village there were two siblings from the Luo Jiwu household.
